ayahOccurrences.text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form VIII) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَٱشْتَعَلَ is in the derivative form: اشْتَعَل
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ش/ع/ل   sh–ʿ–l to set on fire, to inflame, to kindle, to blaze, to burn brightly. Of this root, اشْتَعَل ʾishtaʿala occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
اشْتَعَل ʾishtaʿala [v. VIII, intrans.] to catch fire, to blaze, to be aflame *

(19:4) وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا and [my] head has become aflame with greyness.
